name: Fernando de Noronha
tagline: Brazil's protected island of dolphins and perfect beaches
summary: Fernando de Noronha is a volcanic archipelago 350 km off Brazil, with visitor numbers limited to protect it. Swim at Baía do Sancho, often voted the world's best beach, watch spinner dolphins in their bay at dawn, snorkel with turtles and sharks, and hike the coastal trails.
seasonNote: August to January is dry with clear water; surf season is December to March.
arrival: Flights from Recife or Natal; a daily environmental tax plus a park fee apply.
gettingAround: Buggy rental or the island bus; some trails need booking.
cashTip: Cards and Pix work almost everywhere; carry some reais for beach vendors. A 10 percent service charge is usually added.
foodTip: Fresh fish, seafood and Pernambuco dishes.
